title: Research Data Request
scenario: Someone in your course asks for raw survey data with participant names included.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Research Data Request: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Protect personal data and follow research privacy rules.
